rationale: A routine dishwasher fault with no safety risk (002). The landlord has not answered the request to send a contractor for three days (004, 006). Chasing the landlord once is the standard next step. The agency instead restarted the 3-day wait (007) and the landlord approved the next day (009), so a dated follow-up is also acceptable. Booking without the approval that the system itself requires (003) is wrong.
